“um aumento de 6% em relação a abril de 2025”

checks.evidence: “O cliente pode adiar a entrega” is Portuguese.
“O cliente pode adiar a entrega uma única vez” preserves permission and the one-time limit.
“avisando por escrito com pelo menos 4 dias úteis de antecedência” specifies the required notice.
“O pagamento já devido continua obrigatório.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the permission, notice condition, and continuing payment obligation.

checks.evidence: “O cliente pode adiar a entrega” is Portuguese.

“desde que avise por escrito com pelo menos 4 dias úteis de antecedência”
“O pagamento já devido continua obrigatório.”

checks.evidence: “Envía el informe solo cuando” is Spanish.
“solo cuando Ana y Luis lo hayan aprobado por escrito” makes both written approvals a prerequisite.
“solo cuando Ana y Luis lo hayan aprobado” excludes approval by just one person, although it does not repeat that exclusion separately.
“El silencio no cuenta como aprobación.”

ratings.reason: Preserves all substantive safeguards. The insufficiency of one approval is conveyed through the requirement for both.

checks.evidence: “Envía el informe solo si” is Spanish.
“solo si Ana y Luis lo han aprobado por escrito”
“La aprobación de uno solo no basta.”
“La falta de respuesta no cuenta como aprobación.”

ratings.reason: Preserves all conditions and explicitly restates both safeguards against treating incomplete approval as sufficient.

cases.preference_reason: Both preserve meaning, but B retains the explicit warning that one approval is insufficient, making the operational safeguard easier to notice.

checks.evidence: “Le coût est estimé” is French.
“estimé à 2 900 € HT par trimestre”
“HT” denotes exclusion of tax; “auxquels s’ajoutent 450 € de frais d’installation” places installation outside the quarterly amount.
“Ce montant est indicatif et ne constitue pas un devis ferme.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the estimate, quarterly unit, excluded costs, and nonbinding-quote caveat. Adding the installation charge is supported by its exclusion from the stated cost.

checks.evidence: “Le coût est estimé” is French.
“estimé à 2 900 euros par trimestre”
“hors TVA. Les frais d’installation de 450 euros ne sont pas inclus.”
“Cette estimation n’est pas un devis ferme.”

ratings.reason: Preserves all source meaning with explicit exclusions and a clear estimate caveat.

cases.preference_reason: Both clearly preserve the amounts, quarterly basis, exclusions, and uncertainty; their presentation differences are minor.
